title: Philippine Money: Coins and Bills up to ₱100
seo_title: Grade 1 Philippine Money Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Recognize coins (excluding centavo coins) and bills up to ₱100 and their notations; determine the value of a number of bills and/or a number of coins (excluding centavo coins) up to ₱100; compare different denominations of peso coins and bills up to ₱100; solve 1-step problems (given orally or in pictures) involving addition of money where the sum is up to ₱100.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 Philippine money worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: peso coins and bills up to ₱100, counting, comparing and shopping problems. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_big: Count the value, not the number of coins.
key_sub: Start with the biggest value and count on.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Peso coins: ₱1, ₱5, ₱10 and ₱20. Bills: ₱20, ₱50 and ₱100. The sign for peso is ₱.
  • To count money, start with the biggest value and count on: ₱50, ₱60, ₱65, ₱66.
  • Count the value, not the number of coins: three ₱1 coins are less than one ₱5 coin.
  • To find the total cost, add the prices.

Examples

Example

₱50 bill, ₱10 coin, ₱5 coin

50, 60, 65

Answer: ₱65

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting coins, not valueAdd the values.
Bigger coin, more moneyRead the number on it.
Subtracting“In all” means add.
